text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first G1 race of the Tiara tour is over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a once-in-a-lifetime experience, and Daiwa Scarlet is probably the most exhausted she's ever been.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That being the case, I decide to give her the day off. Or… that was the plan, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Check it out! Scarlet and Vodka are going at it again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wow! Vodka, you can do it! Scarlet, give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You have got to be kidding me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I won! That makes eight out of thirteen!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All righty. Time to head back. No point in wearin' myself out here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hey! Come back here! You can't just leave while you're ahead!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …Hmph! I'm not even that tired. Honestly, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I was just doing some solo training this morning when she asked me to run with her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, crud.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I walk her back to her dorm to make sure she doesn't do any more training in secret.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh. You're acting like a real helicopter parent, you know?! I don't need to be babysat…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh? Is that…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You're really planning on going for it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm here.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Please… Give me some advice.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, well. I never thought I'd see Vodka bow like that to anyone, let alone to Brian.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: She's getting advice from a veteran, huh. Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Fine! You've made your point!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Air Groove is back yet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet speeds off toward her dorm with suspicious enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, everyone's abuzz with shocking news about the Japanese Oaks, the second race of the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka isn't entering the Japanese Oaks? She's running in the Derby instead?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No way! She's dropping out of the Tiara tour? What happened to beating me?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it. She's actually running from our contest.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: All that talk about being cool, and she just ups and changes her tour, just like that! That's so far from cool…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good grief… All that energy I built up… All for nothing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh… I guess I must have collapsed back there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Precisely. You've been sneaking out of the dorm to train again, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Air Groove?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You should thank your lucky stars that there were people around. Can you imagine if you had collapsed all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah… You're right. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And as for you, Trainer… You must keep a cool head at all times. Panicking like you did back there won't help Scarlet any.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Her future in your hands—and you'd do best to remember that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I've taken the liberty of calling your roommate to collect you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: My roommate? You can't mean…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What'd you go and faint for? You're not setting a very good standard, Miss Model Student.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Quiet, you!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Besides, you're the one being lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …What?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You gave up on the Tiara tour, right? You figured you couldn't get first place with me in the running.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: In fact, I'll just say it. You quit halfway through, like a coward!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Like hell I did!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm running the Derby to break through to a whole 'nother level of cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm no coward! You just don't have a clue!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Besides, that's pretty rich coming from you! Aren't you the one who keeps going on about being number one without even knowing what that means?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ex-cuse me?! What's that supposed to mean?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Exactly! You tell me! What does being number one even look like?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Is it just taking first place? Then you should just run in races you know you can win, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Don't make me laugh! That's not what being number one means at all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Then what does it mean? Do you even know?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I… That's…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: See. You don't even have an answer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Your "number one" is meaningless… Just empty words.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …You're wrong.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're wrong! My dream is nothing like that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But in the end, Daiwa Scarlet can't find the words to refute Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biting her lip, she ponders what it means to be "number one."
